sub_strands.name: Number Concept and Whole Numbers
performance_indicators: Count concrete items forward and backward sequentially from 1 up to 100.
Read and write whole numbers from 1 up to 100 in structural symbols.
Identify the place value of digits up to tens (tens and ones) using place value tins or charts.

sub_strands.name: Operations
performance_indicators: Add a 2-digit number to a 2-digit number with regrouping up to a sum of 100.
Subtract a 2-digit number from a 2-digit number with regrouping up to 100.
Multiply single-digit numbers using repeated addition concepts up to 5x5.
Divide numbers up to 25 using equal sharing or grouping concepts without reminders.

sub_strands.name: Fractions and Patterns
performance_indicators: Identify a half (1/2) and a quarter (1/4) using concrete objects and paper cutouts.
Work out missing terms in mathematical number patterns that progress up to 100.

sub_strands.name: Length, Mass, and Capacity
performance_indicators: Measure and compare length of objects in fixed standard meters (m).
Compare mass of varying items against a standard one-kilogram (kg) measure.
Estimate and measure the fluid capacity of clean containers using standard liters (l).

sub_strands.name: Time and Money
performance_indicators: Read and tell time by the hour on both digital and analog clock faces.
Identify days of the week and sequence events using a monthly calendar layout.
Count and make change with Kenyan currency denominations up to 200 Shillings.

sub_strands.name: Lines and Shapes
performance_indicators: Model straight and curved lines using local wires, ropes, or drawing tools.
Identify, sort, and sketch rectangles, circles, triangles, and squares within the classroom environment.

sub_strands.name: Conversational Listening and Talking
performance_indicators: Pronounce multi-syllable vocabulary words clearly with appropriate phonetic inflection.
Listen attentively to instructions and accurately complete structural three-step tasks.
Express individual feelings, descriptions, and logical requests during group interactions.

sub_strands.name: Fluency and Word Recognition
performance_indicators: Read grade-appropriate text fragments aloud smoothly at an optimal pace.
Apply basic phonetic blending to decipher unfamiliar vocabulary during independent reading.
Recognize standard high-frequency sight words instantaneously inside context.

sub_strands.name: Reading Comprehension
performance_indicators: Answer implicit and explicit analytical questions based directly on a read text block.
Relate events from a fictional narrative to localized real-life daily encounters.

sub_strands.name: Guided and Independent Expression
performance_indicators: Form uniform upper-case and lower-case letters with appropriate spacing along standard rulings.
Construct grammatically correct simple sentences incorporating capital letters and full stops.
Spell common foundational vocabulary accurately during continuous writing exercises.

sub_strands.name: Utamkaji na Maongezi
performance_indicators: Kutamka sauti changamano na silabi za Kiswahili kwa ufasaha mkubwa.
Kushiriki katika mazungumzo ya darasani kwa kutumia msamiati mwafaka na sentensi sahihi.
Kutoa maelezo mafupi kuhusu matukio ya kila siku nyumbani na shuleni.

sub_strands.name: Kusoma kwa Ufasaha na Ufahamu
performance_indicators: Kusoma vifungu vifupi vya hadithi kwa kasi na matamshi yanayofaa.
Kutambua alama za uandishi kama vile kiulizi na kitone wakati wa kusoma kwa sauti.
Kujibu maswali ya ufahamu yanayotokana na makala au hadithi zilizosomwa.

sub_strands.name: Uandishi na Tahajia
performance_indicators: Kuandika maneno na sentensi fupi kwa usafi, mwachano unaofaa, na tahajia sahihi.
Kanakili sentensi na aya fupi kutoka ubaoni au vitabuni bila makosa.

sub_strands.name: Weather Patterns and Soil Care
performance_indicators: Observe, measure, and tabulate recurring atmospheric features over a weekly timeline.
Differentiate local soil types based on tactile texture, grain properties, and agricultural utility.
Practice simple environmental conservation measures, including safe waste disposal.

sub_strands.name: Plants, Animals, and Hygiene
performance_indicators: Identify domestic and wild animals in the locality and list basic conservation methods.
Practice personal cleanliness steps, including ear, nose, and oral cavity preservation.
Demonstrate proper cleaning and care protocols for personal and school utilities.

sub_strands.name: Community and Administration
performance_indicators: Outline the administrative structure, symbols, and values promoted within their school community.
Describe standard professional tasks executed by different local community helpers.

sub_strands.name: Emergency Preparedness
performance_indicators: Identify potential household and classroom safety hazards and describe avoidance strategies.
Demonstrate correct immediate responses during accidental fire drills and emergency scenarios.

sub_strands.name: Two and Three Dimensional Forms
performance_indicators: Create artistic drawings using mixed coloring mediums and shading methods.
Print rhythmic patterns using local templates like sponge cutouts or textured leaves.
Construct usable structural items using safe, non-toxic household waste materials.

sub_strands.name: Vocal and Instrumental Presentation
performance_indicators: Sing localized cultural and patriotic anthems cleanly with proper breath control.
Play simple percussion and rhythmic instruments in unison during group arrangements.

sub_strands.name: Locomotor and Non-Locomotor Skills
performance_indicators: Execute stable balancing postures on varying parts of the body during floor play.
Demonstrate proper form while skipping, leaping, and crawling within explicit boundaries.

sub_strands.name: The Holy Bible and Family Values
performance_indicators: Identify the Old and New Testaments as foundational components of the Christian Holy Bible.
Retell biblical narratives detailing the childhood, choices, and kindness of Jesus.
Demonstrate obedience, truthfulness, and helpful behavior patterns inside their immediate family.

sub_strands.name: Surahs, Hadith, and Akhlaq
performance_indicators: Recite and apply core short Surahs from the Holy Quran, including Surah Al-Asr.
Identify the essential attributes of Allah as the Supreme Omnipotent Creator.
Apply standard Islamic codes of conduct when greeting and interacting with peers.

sub_strands.name: Foundational Moral Architectures
performance_indicators: Demonstrate empathy, patience, and a sharing attitude during competitive peer interactions.
Practice telling the absolute truth and taking responsibility for minor mistakes.
Internalize positive behavior patterns through systematic institutional mentorship.
